title: Jana Nayagan Advance Booking Crosses ₹15 Crore as Vijay's Final Film Nears July 23 Release
excerpt: Thalapathy Vijay's political thriller, his last movie before full-time politics, will release on 7,000 to 8,000 screens worldwide — one of the largest rollouts in Indian cinema history.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Jana Nayagan will release on July 23, 2026, across 7,000 to 8,000 screens worldwide.
  • Advance bookings have surpassed ₹15 crore, with Tamil Nadu contributing over ₹5 crore.
  • The film marks Vijay's final acting role before fully entering politics with TVK.
  • Jana Nayagan's plot parallels MGR's legacy, reflecting Vijay's political journey.
  • The film's release is a significant cultural event for the Tamil diaspora globally.

  • Jana Nayagan, directed by H. Vinoth and starring Vijay, will release on July 23, 2026, on an estimated 7,000 to 8,000 screens globally.
  • Advance booking has crossed ₹15 crore worldwide, with Tamil Nadu alone accounting for over ₹5 crore and projections pointing to a ₹50–60 crore opening day.
  • The film is Vijay's final acting role before he devotes himself fully to his political party, Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), which won 108 seats in the May 2026 Tamil Nadu assembly elections.
  • The movie's political thriller plot — a police officer turned people's leader — deliberately echoes MGR's cinematic legacy and Vijay's own political trajectory.

Advance bookings for Jana Nayagan, the final film of Tamil superstar and politician Vijay, crossed ₹15 crore globally as of July 20, with trade analysts projecting an opening day gross between ₹50 crore and ₹60 crore when the movie hits theatres on July 23.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=9DBX7OOqaqc

Directed by H. Vinoth and produced by KVN Productions, the political thriller will release on an estimated 7,000 to 8,000 screens worldwide — placing it in the same league as recent blockbusters like Jawan (10,000 screens) and Pushpa 2: The Rule (12,000 screens). For a film driven primarily by the Tamil market, the scale is unprecedented.

The MGR Parallel

The movie has drawn extensive comparisons to the legacy of M.G. Ramachandran, the actor-turned-politician who founded the AIADMK and served as Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister from 1977 until his death in 1987. Like MGR, Vijay has leveraged his cinematic stardom to build a political movement — and Jana Nayagan leans into the parallel deliberately.
